signIn.notSetUpTitle: Trybun is not set up yet
signIn.notSetUpText: Open the setup link printed by <command>./trybun install</command>, or run <command>./trybun setup-token</command> on the server for a new link.

administration.title: Administration
administration.allDone: Everything on this list is set up.

configure_github_sign_in.title: Configure GitHub sign-in
configure_github_sign_in.description: Team members sign in with GitHub. Required before you can invite the team.

configure_email.title: Configure e-mail
configure_email.description: Without an SMTP server Trybun sends no e-mail, so invitation links have to be passed on by hand.

setup.title: Set up Trybun
setup.intro: Create the first Administrator account. You set up two-factor authentication when you sign in for the first time.
setup.invalidTitle: This setup link is invalid or has expired
setup.invalidText: Run <command>./trybun setup-token</command> on the server for a new link.
setup.passwordDescription: You sign in with this password and a one-time code from an authenticator app.
setup.systemDefaults: Default language of the system: {language}; default time zone: {timeZone}. Both are set in <file>.env</file> and changed there, followed by <command>docker compose up -d --wait</command>.
setup.doneText: Sign in with your e-mail address and password. Trybun then asks you to set up two-factor authentication with an authenticator app.
